about: The four tool poses bam_ruckig was given for the UR5e trajectory in ../data/workspace-dev-029.npz: the start, two via points and the end (ruckig_form via). Tool = the dataset station TCP (flange + 0.144 m, the BAM claw), in the URDF root link base_link_ur, metres and xyzw quaternions.
source: trajectory_tracking_agent datasets/ur5e_alone/workspace/v2/tasks.jsonl, task workspace-dev-029, field keyposes (4x4); a byte-for-byte copy of arm_motion_bench datasets/ur5e_alone/workspace/v2 (1ba1d8c, 2026-11-23)

limits.why: the dataset README: timed by bam_ruckig (jerk-limited, time-optimal) at the UR5e limits pi rad/s, 6 rad/s2, 60 rad/s3 per joint; the npz carries lo/hi/vmax/amax but not the jerk limit
